title: Santa's Sleigh
seo_title: Santa's Sleigh Charcuterie Board: Christmas Showpiece & List
description: A Santa's sleigh charcuterie board for 12 to 15: six cheese-stick reindeer pulling a bread sleigh piled with cheese presents across a snowfield.
hook: Six reindeer pull a bread sleigh piled with cheese presents across a snowfield.

items.name: Extra prosciutto or soppressata for the board

why: The reindeer are cheese sticks wrapped in prosciutto, with pretzel antlers, so you can make all six the day before. The sleigh is bread, piled with presents of cheddar and pepper jack cubes.
Salami, summer sausage and mozzarella pearls fill the snowfield. It's the Christmas board kids talk about.

timeline.what: Build the 6 reindeer and refrigerate them, covered, on a tray. Cut and tie the cheese presents. Grate the Parmesan.
Hollow the bread sleigh and lay the snowfield.
Set the sleigh, the reindeer and the reins, then fill the board.
Stand the rosemary trees and add the cranberries.

faq.q: How do you make cheese stick reindeer?
faq.a: Wrap white cheddar or mozzarella sticks in prosciutto for the bodies, use smaller pieces for the heads and legs and add pretzel antlers. The book has the exact cuts.
About 2 hours, mostly the reindeer. Make them the day before.

Make the reindeer and cube the cheese presents the day before. Keep meat, cheese and cut fruit out no more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F. For a long party, build half, keep the refill in the fridge and top it up halfway through.
